name: LIVING SPLASH — the key art rendered live, five pips under it, one tap to play
thesis: The splash image stops being a picture. #menu becomes two dark-violet cosmos bands (our #33175e→#0d0821, not Hole.io's #4c3cbe) with a feathered oval window in the middle, and through the window the child sees the REAL island she is about to play — the current world, already built and already rendering behind the opaque menu today (createIsland top-level await prototype3d.ts:1733; renderer.render unconditional :10948-10957) — framed by a parked menu camera on the world's hero landmark with the void creature perched in the lower third looking up at it, breathing, blinking, chomping, while the waterfall scrolls (Maple), the bay swells (Pirate), the balloon drifts, the crowd walks. Under the window: five pips (the world's EAT/SET/LANDMARK/RIVALS/CLEAR ladder), one goal line, one full-width PLAY, three tabs. Cost of the diorama itself is zero new rendering: it is a CSS window plus a camera branch plus a freeze list plus a menu-only quality rung. The 30-level ladder lives in one versioned key (voidLevels) that only ever raises state, so nobody is re-locked.
screen_layout: Reference 430x932 @ DPR2, safe-area top 47px / bottom 34px. Bands top→bottom (px = % of 932): [A] 0–7% (0–65px) STATUS STRIP: #btnSettings gear at left (existing absolute top-left, index.html:1507), #coins chip at right (z11, already above #menu, :1819), nothing else — violet ground. [B] 7–16% (65–149px) IDENTITY: the 3-layer logo type kept but capped at 60px cap-height on one line; beneath it the .tag element is repurposed as the WORLD CHIP 'MAPLE FALLS ▸ · LEVEL 2 OF 5' (tap opens the existing #worlds poster picker, see tabs). [C] 16–65% (149–606px = 457px = 49%) DIORAMA WINDOW: #menu paints its violet gradient with a CSS mask-image (radial, ellipse 96% x 100% centred at 50% 40% of the band, feather 48px) so the WebGL canvas shows through as an oval floating in the cosmos — the island IS the key art's floating island. #eventRibbon (season) sits as a 28px pill at the top edge of the window (y 157–185px) only when .show. The void's face is authored into the lower third of the window (y ≈ 455–600px) by the camera, so nothing DOM ever covers it. [D] 65–72% (606–671px) LADDER: five pips centred on a 300px track at y 614–650px (pip 36x36, current 46x46, gap 18px), and under them the GOAL LINE at 16px/700: 'EAT 48,000 POINTS' (level 1) / 'EAT 8 CARS · 5 HOUSES · 40 SNACKS' (2) / 'EAT THE TOWN HALL' (3) / 'BE THE BIGGEST VOID' (4) / 'EAT EVERYTHING' (5); the BY MYSELF chip (#soloTog, 28px) sits at the right end of the goal line, hidden on level 4. [E] 72–81% (671–755px) PLAY: #btnPlay full width (398x64, 16px side gutters), our existing PLAY green with a 2px cream rim (the measured 17.9:1 rim trick, recon :238), label 'PLAY', a 2.4 s breathe of ±2% scale only (declared amplitude for the probe). [F] 81–100% (755–932px) TAB BAR: three 72px tabs SHOP | HOME | BOOK (y 763–835px), each with its own hue band (SHOP deep teal #124a5c, HOME our violet #33175e, BOOK warm plum #5a1d4e), active tab lifts 6px with a white 3px underline; below, 34px home-indicator safe area in the darkest ground #0d0821. The 49% window plus 7% pips plus 9% PLAY = the Hole.io proportions (recon :25-27) on our palette.
hero_diorama: WHAT IS RENDERED: the existing single scene — no second renderer, no second island (rebuild-in-place is out: 56 pickedWorld sites, 44 island.* sites, :1698). The subject per world is the hero landmark COPY.hero (:1558/:1584/:1608/:1631/:1653) and for Maple (hero:null, :1501) the Town Hall at 3D (42.75,−68) (island.ts:8065, SQ_CX 219/SQ_HALL_Y 220). CAMERA: a fourth branch beside ASSETVIEW/TOPDOWN at prototype3d.ts:10488-10494 (`else if (onMenu)`), writing camera.position/lookAt directly and never camOffset/camDist/camFollow/targetDist; it sets a module `menuDist = 58` that is passed to updateLodBias/fitShadow (:10894-10895), crowdGate (:10277) and fog (:10647) in place of camDist while onMenu. Geometry: pivot P = landmark position; the void is parked (the __warpVoid pattern :2262-2270: voidState.x/z + camFollow.copy) at P + 26 units toward the camera side (azimuth a0 chosen per world so the camera looks INTO the island wedge from near the rim, keeping the frustum off the far plateau); camera at distance 58 from the void, height 24, lookAt = void position + (0, 6, 0) biased 40% toward P, so the landmark fills the upper half of the window and the void's face sits in the lower third. Maple's a0 is chosen so the SE-rim waterfall (3D (190,207.5), island.ts:3812-3838) is NOT in frame — it is 240 units from the Town Hall; the live water Maple gets at launch is none (pond/river are painted into the bake, island.ts:3119-3249); stream 5 adds a one-draw-call pond sheet on the pirate pattern. MOTION BUDGET (60 fps reference): orbit is a PENDULUM, not a full turn — azimuth = a0 + 12°·sin(2πt/24 s), peak 0.052°/frame ≈ 0.24 px/frame at the landmark on the 457px window, never > 0.5 px/frame (recon :629 '~0.3 px/frame'), so the far side of the island never enters the frustum; void: breathe ±1.6% and blink cadence (void3d.ts:2050, :2297-2310, free), mood 'cruise' via voidling.setMood (rig API, never _dbg), a gaze-up at the landmark via lookX/lookY (void3d.ts:16) every 6–9 s for 1.4 s, one chomp(k=0.6) (void3d.ts:75) every 14 s preceded by 0.8 s of 'hungry'; world idles that already tick free in island.update (:4011-4028): Maple balloon orbit and waterfall scroll/spray pulse, Pirate bay swell (one draw, :3880-3931), star twinkle, curios spin (:9487), life.update crowd (kept, :10281, gate = menuDist·2.2+90 = 218 units); WHAT IS FROZEN while onMenu: attract mode (:9849, else the hero wanders off the mark), fadeOccluders (:10896, walks all edibles), rivals.update (:10290 — the family is NOT in the diorama, boot and post-HOME menus then match), bubbles.update (:10364, no DOM chatter over the menu), the edible eat loop (already broken on !started, :10367), refreshHud (:10810). KEY ART COMPOSITION: kept — island floating in a dark-violet cosmos (the oval window IS the floating island against the void ground, the gradient bands and ::before star dots stay), the void below the landmark looking UP at it (creature face in the lower third, gaze-up beat); partly kept — 'waterfall off the edge' is live only on Maple when the world chip is in the waterfall's wedge, otherwise it is the bay swell on Pirate and nothing on the four dry worlds (Lantern canal is ankle-deep :410, Powder lake is ice :430, Skylark/Game Day have no water :434/:458); NOT kept — houses and trees drifting down into the void's mouth (no cheap 3D route; a DOM sprite drift would break the 'menu UI does not move' rule) — the chomp beat is its replacement; the giant purple face at the bottom of the frame is NOT kept (the void stays his real size, a creature in the scene, not a poster mouth). On the post-HOME menu the camera eases from the match position to the parked orbit over 900 ms (single lerp on camera.position, not camFollow); on PLAY the snap is free because beginMatch sets camDist = DESCENT_START and the follow spring takes the authored position at lerp 1 while armed (:6151, :10629).
ladder_presentation: Five pips per world under the window (band D), numbered 1–5 inside the pip, in this world's order EAT / SET / LANDMARK / RIVALS / CLEAR. States and looks (our palette, Hole.io's roles): DONE = flat slate-grey #5d6a92 with a small white tick; CLEAR (pip 5 at 100% devoured, or any pip later re-run to 100%) = magenta #b23bc9 with a white star; CURRENT = green #46d54a gradient, 46px (1.28x the 36px neighbours), white 3px ring, a 2.4 s ring-glow pulse (declared amplitude); LOCKED = blue #98affd at 55% alpha with a padlock glyph, no number. Every adjacent pair and every pip against the #1c0f3d ground must clear deltaE >= 10 (the lockedcards Lab method, qa/lockedcards.mjs:41-49) and the padlock glyph p10 contrast >= 3:1. Tapping a DONE or CLEAR pip re-plays that level (sets the in-page play goal, then the same one-tap path); tapping a LOCKED pip does a 6px shake and the goal line reads 'FINISH LEVEL 2 FIRST' for 1.2 s; the CURRENT pip and PLAY are the same action. Above the pips nothing; the global count 'LEVEL 7 OF 30' appears only on the end card as the level bar (Hole.io's 1/14), never on the menu — a six-year-old reads five circles, not thirty. World progression is shown by the world chip in band B, and by the end card's next-reward island. Solo: the pips record identically except level 4 (RIVALS) which always brings the family (the BY MYSELF chip hides on level 4).

level_flow: MENU (body.menu set; camera parked; pips painted from voidLevels; goal line from LEVELS[world][cur.goal]) → tap PLAY (#btnPlay, 1 tap; first-ever session still auto-plays Maple level 1 with no menu at all, :6559-6562) → playGoal = cur.goal for the built world; menuEl.style.display='none', body.menu removed (:6185), launchWorld() (:6503) → withWorldReady → startFresh(soloOn() && goal!==4) → beginMatch (:6081): bumpMatch unchanged (:6139), heroProp resolved (:6114), goal object built {type,target,kinds[3],count[3],met:false,result:null}, #titlecard filled per match (.lvl 'LEVEL 2', .name the world name, .sub the goal line, replacing the one-time fill at :1674-1677) BEFORE armed=true (:6144); camera snaps to DESCENT_START (:6151) → ARMED idle, clock at 0 → first touch: startMatch (:6297-6303) starts the clock AND the music (:6329) — owner's decision, already true → GOAL CARD rolls at 0.5 s for 0.6 s (:9512-9518, GOAL_CARD_AT/LEN untouched) → HUD: #timer as today; #growth as today; a new #goalHud in the slot #quests used to hold: EAT = a 4px target bar + '31,200 / 48,000' (playerScore :3704 checked per frame — it can fall on a steal :2945, the bar may retreat, the WIN latches on first crossing); SET = three chips icon+count counting DOWN '8 🚗 → 7' fed at the eat handler's kind lines (:5825-5839, identical rules to qa/questable.mjs:74-90, 'big' deduped per bite); LANDMARK = chip '🏛️ TOWN HALL · you 3.2 / need 5.9' until the hero cue (:10753) then 'GO!'; RIVALS = rank chip '#3 OF 6' from the 5 Hz myRank (:4732-4737) with the crown; CLEAR = '% DEVOURED 41%' bar from devouredPct (:4886) → WIN ON THE SPOT: one goalMet() check inside the `started && !ended && !paused` block beside the buzzer (:9681): sets goal.result='win', outroT=2.0 (same slow-mo rings/music ceremony, :9480/:10203/:10562); RIVALS resolves only at the buzzer (myRank===1); buzzer with goal unmet sets goal.result='time'. LANDMARK eaten by a rival → goal.result='stolen' = fail with the line 'THE FAMILY GOT THERE FIRST' (heroProp is excluded from rivals' eating on level 3 as the fix; :10770-10774) → endMatch(result) (:5324, given a parameter) → END CARD over the dimmed live world (#end z9 blur, :708): #endHd 'LEVEL 2 DONE!' / 'TIME'S UP' / '%d% DEVOURED' (CLEAR), then NEW #endPips (the five pips, this level's pip flips grey/magenta with a 300 ms pop, inserted between #endHd and #endSub and painted before celebrateEnd() is called at :5364/:5439 so it lights ≤ 400 ms before the 900 ms coin count-up), #endSub coins/gems/XP as today, the level bar 'LEVEL 7 OF 30', #endStats tiles unchanged (0.15–0.98 s cascade), #drop hold-to-open unchanged, #endNext = NEXT REWARD: the next pip drawn large with its goal line, or when this was pip 5 (or the world's first finish, completeWorld :5503 unchanged) the next world's poster painted by paintWorldCard(host, WORLD_ORDER[i+1]) (:6689) with the .locked filter and padlock, TAKE ME THERE reload path unchanged (:5518-5520); #endQuests deleted → footer: #btnAgain relabelled CONTINUE (win: next level, same world, no reload — resetMatch :7695 with playGoal+1) or TRY AGAIN (fail: same level), #btnHome → menu (body.menu, camera eases to the orbit). ON A FAIL: nothing is lost — no lives, no timer pressure, no ad, the pip stays green, voidLevels.w[world][goal].n++ and best is kept, the sub line says the honest distance ('31,200 of 48,000 — so close'); on the 3rd fail of the same goal the NEXT pip also opens (fail-forward, the 'never a wall' invariant of unlocks.ts:5-26; the skipped pip stays green-and-open so it can still be earned) and the end card says 'YOU CAN SKIP AHEAD'. Quit via ⌂ LEAVE (:7774) records n++ only.
state_model: NEW FILE src/game/levels.ts (~130 lines, beside unlocks.ts). KEY 'voidLevels', JSON object (matchdeck/voidStats convention, not unlocks' CSV): { v:1, cur:{world, goal:1..5}, w:{ [world]: { [1..5]: { st:'locked'|'open'|'done'|'clear', best:number (score for EAT, kinds-left-min for SET, seconds for LANDMARK, rank for RIVALS, pct for CLEAR), pct:number (best devouredPct on that pip), first:'YYYY-MM-DD' (toDateString convention of voidFirstWinDay :5395), n:number (attempts) } } } }. Missing entries read as 'locked' except maple/1 which is always at least 'open' (the read()-adds-maple invariant, unlocks.ts:50). Every read/write in try/catch (unlocks.ts:48/54); unknown fields kept (stickers.ts:449); version gate `if ((d.v??0) < LEVELS_VER) migrate(); track('save_migrated',{key:'voidLevels'})` (voidSaveVer precedent :8213-8230). RULES: within a world goal k+1 opens when goal k is 'done'/'clear' or when goal k has n>=3 (fail-forward); between worlds the binding finish rule stays — world W+1 goal 1 is 'open' iff isUnlocked(W+1) (unlocks.ts stays the between-worlds authority, completeWorld :5503 unchanged and ALSO called from the solo branch before its early return at :5364-5370, which today never unlocks world 2 for a solo-only child). 'cur' = the frontier: the lowest non-done goal of the lowest world with an open goal; replaying an old pip sets a transient in-page `playGoal` at beginMatch (beside bumpMatch :6139) and never moves cur; a replay may raise 'done' → 'clear' when devouredPct===100. MIGRATION (runs on every read path like unlocks.migrate() :61-74, only ever raises): for each w in WORLD_ORDER: if isUnlocked(w) → w/1 at least 'open'; if voidBest_<w> > 0 (:5449) → w/1 'done' with best=voidBest_<w> (no regression for anyone who finished a rivals match) and w/2 'open'; voidBestPct (:5339, global, not per-world) is never turned into a 'clear'. QA seeds of voidUnlocked CSV (40+ probes, qa/unlocks.mjs:53) therefore read as 'goal 1 open in every seeded world' with no probe edits. CROSSING THE RELOAD: the picker/ribbon/TAKE ME THERE reload paths add 'voidPlayGoal' next to voidAutoPlay (:6769, :5519), consumed at :6840-6841 the same way; ?g= mirrors ?w= (:355) for probes. WRITE BOUNDARY: one function recordLevelResult({world, goal, result, score, pct, rank, secs}) called in endMatch immediately after `ended=true; voidPlayed` (:5329-5330) before the solo return. READ BOUNDARIES: menu pips + goal line (new paint fn), picker cards (:6704 forEach), end card #endPips/#endNext, and two QA hooks beside __matchState (:2289): __levels() → the 30-entry array {world,n,kind,st} and __menuState() → {world, goal, azimuth, menuDist, orbiting, menuRung, drawCalls (renderer.info), frame}. Untouched: voidUnlocked, voidBest_<w>, voidBestPct, voidMatchN (match 0 stays the baseline, matchdeck.ts:11-18), voidSolo, stickers, trophies, seasons. Deleted after the board goes: voidQuestDay/State/EncoreIds/EncoreN (:3954-4003).
perf_plan: MEASURE FIRST (no menu-idle number exists; qa/_refute_perframe.mjs is in-match only): a probe samples dtRaw and renderer.info.render.calls/triangles for 120 hand-cranked frames (virtualised rAF, the qa/ladder.mjs:65-76 technique) with #menu up on each of the six worlds at __pinQuality(0) and (3), before any change, then again with the parked camera; the printed line says 'sandbox, not device'. BUDGET BARS: draw calls at the parked orbit ≤ 1.6x the same world's settled-play count (Maple: ≤ ~2,000 against 1,241, :10496-10500 — the 4,694-call intro height is the frame we are avoiding by the close 58-unit wedge); menu/match median frame-time ratio ≤ 1.15 on the same page and rung; owner's device bar: menu ≤ 16.7 ms on the reference phone (polish-plan :120), read from __menuState on the daughter's iPhone through the Capacitor shell, never from the sandbox. MENU RUNG (never through applyQuality — its shadow branch sets the one-way qShadowLatch :1354 and rebuilds ~45 programs at 1,677 ms :1340): on menu entry bloomOn=false (:1303 module let, read at :10948), renderer.setPixelRatio(min(devicePixelRatio, qLevel<=1 ? 1.6 : 1.15)) (:1315 pattern), shadows kept ON at rungs 0–1 (the close diorama wants its shadow) and OFF at rungs 2–3 via the intro toggle only (renderer.shadowMap.enabled=false; sun.castShadow=false, :10505-10509; renderer.compile() pre-warmed once at boot after the first frame so the first-toggle recompile (docs/AUDIT-2026-08-23.md:316) never lands on a menu frame — verified by the probe's first-frame dt). On leaving the menu: restore shadows the intro way, then applyQuality() (a no-op on shadows when the state already matches, :1333). The adaptive ladder (:10912, gated on started) stays inert on the menu and __quality() never changes there, so qa/ladder.mjs's MENU GATE (:106-114) stays green; the menu has its OWN 3-step degrade `menuRung` (exposed in __menuState, never written to qLevel): if the in-page median dtRaw over the last 120 frames > 20 ms → step 1 DPR 1.0; still > 20 ms → step 2 shadows off (intro toggle); still → step 3 orbit frozen and render every second rAF (30 fps; dt fed to island.update doubled so the water keeps its speed). IDLE/BATTERY: document.hidden → no render (visibilitychange gate on the rAF at :10957); 60 s without input on the menu → render every second frame; 5 min → orbit frozen, render 1 in 4 (the picture is still live, the phone is not warm). FREEZE LIST cost removed: fadeOccluders (full edibles walk, :1198), rivals.update, bubbles.update, attract-mode nearest-edible scans (:9849-9860), refreshHud. crowdGate at menuDist 58 = 218 units (pirate x2) — life.moverStats(gate) (life.ts:6906) is printed per world by the probe; Lantern (~966 walkers, life.ts:6813) is the world to watch. The hoisted `const onMenu` goes to the TOP of animate() (:9467) and keys on body.menu / endEl.show, never on !started (a since-load latch, :5324/:7776; boot menu started=false vs post-HOME started=true, census :244).
identity_guard: The void is a creature and the diorama proves it: his real body in the real world at real scale, face in the lower third, breathing, blinking, looking UP at the landmark and chomping at it — not a black disc sliding under a city. The ground is OUR dark-violet cosmos with the star dots and the feathered oval that makes the island float (the splash's composition), not Hole.io's flat #4c3cbe slab; the tab hues are teal/violet/plum, not blue/violet/orange. The pips are numbered circles a six-year-old can count, and the goal line is a sentence about eating ('EAT THE TOWN HALL'), never 'consume x items'. The family (rivals) is a family — on level 4 the goal reads 'BE THE BIGGEST VOID', the end card keeps the crown banner and the family standings, and there is no kill-count. No hole physics, no 'swallow the city' skyline collapse: what falls in the key art is replaced by a chomp beat, not by a suction animation. Nothing borrowed that Hole.io uses to pressure: no lives, no hearts, no countdown before PLAY, no 'x2 reward' door, no ad-skip, no currency for retries; a failed level costs nothing and after three tries opens the next pip. Spend still only lives in SHOP behind the parental gate; the menu never sells. The audio contract is untouched: the theme starts on the first real tap (audio3d.ts:459, :317-324), PLAY is that tap, and body.menu stays set so onMenu (:10866) carries the theme. The world picker survives as a poster wall behind the world chip — the 'no void in frame' poster art (:6621-6623) stays the sell for the NEXT world, while the live window is always THIS world with the void in it.
